course_outline_concepts: RLOO (Ahmadian 2024): REINFORCE leave-one-out as a group baseline
REINFORCE++ (2025): global advantage normalisation + variance tracking
GRPO (DeepSeekMath 2024): group-relative advantage with std normalisation + k3 KL inside loss
Dr.GRPO: bias-corrected GRPO - no /std, no 1/|o_i|, and why the original biases mattered
The 2024-2025 shift from value-function methods to group-baseline methods

sources.what_to_extract: RLOO derivation: A_i = r_i - (1/(k-1)) sum_{j!=i} r_j; k in {2,4}; KL as per-token shaped reward; no value net; beats PPO/DPO on TL;DR and HH at ~50% memory; relationship to GRPO (equivalent up to std/clip in the large-k limit).
Global advantage normalization over full mini-batch; per-token shaped reward with KL; PPO-clip retained; k=1 OK; critic-free; hyperparameters (clip 0.2, beta 0.01-0.05, global batch 512-2048).
GRPO objective Eq. 3: group mean/std advantage, PPO-clip, k3 KL in-loss; Algorithm 1 pseudocode; G=64 default; beta=0.04; outcome vs process supervision; critic-free.

Bias derivation: 1/|o_i| causes short-wins / long-wrong-underpenalized; std-normalization causes difficulty bias; Dr.GRPO advantage = r_i - mean(r); token-average by fixed L_max; matches/exceeds GRPO with ~30% shorter completions.
DeepSeekMath 7B recipe: 120B math corpus + GRPO; SFT 46.8 -> RFT 49.0 -> DPO 49.0 -> PPO 51.0 -> GRPO 51.7 on MATH; why critic is dropped (memory + fit bias); full hyperparameters.
Side-by-side comparison table; equivalence-in-the-limit argument (RLOO ~ GRPO w/o std-norm, w/o clip ~ Dr.GRPO); when each wins empirically (continuous RM vs verifiable 0/1 vs small batch).

_compute_loss in trl/trainer/grpo_trainer.py (~L2418-2610); loss_type switch between grpo / dr_grpo / dapo / cispo / bnpo; aggregation-is-the-distinction: grpo = per-sequence token-mean then sample mean; dr_grpo = token-sum / (B * max_completion_length); K3 KL estimator inline.

compute_grpo_outcome_advantage (core_algos.py L290-335): id2mean/id2std dict, norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo toggle = Dr.GRPO mode, n=1 singleton group gets zero advantage, outcome-only rewards, scalar advantage broadcast via response_mask.

Length-normalization bug worked example (50-token vs 500-token correct: same A_i, 10x smaller denominator -> shorter wins); survey of 2025 fixes (Dr.GRPO, Kimi k1.5, sum-not-mean, REINFORCE++); base-model RL trade-off.
On-policy vs off-policy gap: distribution shift (~80%) drives PPO > offline DPO; iterative DPO closes gap. Grounds why 2024-2025 shifted back to online methods (RLOO/GRPO) from offline DPO.

deliverables: figures/group-baseline.html (interactive 2-panel: advantage distribution + gradient-vs-length bias, ~200-280 lines, self-contained, no external CDNs)
hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Derive the equations line-by-line (RLOO leave-one-out identity, GRPO advantage, k3 KL, Dr.GRPO bias correction)
Explain the Dr.GRPO biases numerically - give worked gradient magnitudes, not only narrative
Quote attested parameter values from raw-data sources; label inferred defaults
The four variants must be compared in one table: advantage form, KL form, group size, 2025 adoption
